title: WorldPreset
description: Data file content/world/presets/<id>.json: everything the world generator reads besides the seed (B2 R1-R4, R6, R7, R9, R10, R14, R15). Core values are integers (heights in height units, distances in cells, shares in permille) so generation is exact on every platform (ADR-0002). All values are placeholders until Marcel decides; the budgets follow B2514 T6.

description.description: Short English description of the preset.

generator_version.description: Generator version this preset was tuned for; part of the save game and the world hash (R11).

generation_budget_ms.description: Upper bound for p95 of the generation time (B2514 T6: 10 s).

cell_size_cm.description: Edge length of one cell in centimetres.

chunk_cells.description: Edge length of one chunk in cells; chunks are generated independently from (seed, coordinate).

width_cells.description: Width of the start island area in cells (multiple of chunk_cells).

depth_cells.description: Depth of the start island area in cells (multiple of chunk_cells).

sea_level.description: Height of the calm sea surface in height units.

max_height.description: Highest terrain height in height units; heights stay moderate (R3).

coast_falloff_permille.description: Share of the half width over which land falls off to the sea at the edge.

walkable_slope.description: Largest height difference between neighbouring cells that can be walked; more is an obstacle (R3).

cliff_min_drop.description: Height difference between neighbours from which a cliff is marked.

wavelength_cells.description: Distance between lattice points in cells.

ridged.description: Ridged octave: the noise is folded at its middle and squared, so it adds sharp crests (ridges, hill chains) instead of round bumps. Absent = false.

signed.description: Signed octave: contributes from -amplitude/2 to +amplitude/2 around zero, so it digs hollows as well as raising hills. Absent = false (0 to amplitude).

shallow_max_depth.description: Water up to this depth (height units) is shallow and walkable slowly; deeper only by swimming (R4, R10).

lake_min_cells.description: Smallest hollow (cells below its spill level) that holds water as a pond or lake when a stream or spring feeds it; smaller pits on a stream are filled up to their spill level.

lake_min_depth.description: Smallest depth (spill level minus the deepest ground, height units) of a hollow that holds water; shallower pits on a stream are filled up.

lake_area_per_inflow_permille.description: Largest pond or lake area (cells) per unit of inflow (permille): rain and evaporation balance. A hollow larger than its inflow can fill rises only to that area and has no outflow (closed lake); otherwise it fills to its spill level and overflows.

swamp_max_slope.description: Largest slope of a flat wet hollow that becomes swamp.

swamp_min_moisture_permille.description: Smallest moisture of a cell that becomes swamp.

runoff_per_cell.description: Rain water every land cell adds to the flow accumulation (accumulation units); the accumulation of a cell is the water of all cells that drain through it.

stream_min_accumulation.description: A cell carries a stream where its flow accumulation reaches this value (rain from its catchment plus the springs above it).

channel.description: Width, depth and bank height of a stream by its flow accumulation, interpolated linearly between the points (accumulation ascending); beyond the last point the last values hold.

drink_spots.description: Where drinkable water objects lie: at the springs, along lake and pond edges, along stream banks. Each kind is its own entry; a kind without an entry gets no objects.

WorldPresetWater.description: Hydrology (B2 R4, TL #19722): depressions are filled from the sea inwards (priority flood), every cell drains to its steepest lower neighbour on the filled surface (D8), the flow accumulation sums rain and springs downstream; streams run where it is large enough, fed hollows become ponds and lakes that overflow towards the sea.

climate_id.description: Climate of this world (file id in content/climate): weather states and their change per season (B2 R13).

base_temperature_tenth_c.description: Base temperature at sea level in tenths of a degree Celsius.

temperature_drop_per_100_height.description: Cooling in tenths of a degree per 100 height units (higher is colder, R5).

moisture_water_radius_cells.description: Distance over which water raises the moisture.

valley_moisture_bonus_permille.description: Extra moisture in hollows and valleys.

moisture_noise_permille.description: Strength of the moisture noise, so wet zones (forest, swamp) have natural edges instead of even rings around the water.

moisture_noise_wavelength_cells.description: Wavelength of the moisture noise in cells.

pairs.description: Number of start pairs (B2517: two pairs, each a woman and a man).

min_pair_distance_cells.description: Smallest distance between two pairs; larger than the view range so they do not see each other at start (R9).

max_pair_distance_cells.description: Largest walking distance between two pairs, so they can find each other (B2520).

max_attempts.description: Most generation attempts with derived sub-seeds before the mandatory check is reported as failed (R7).

biome.description: Biome of the start cells (by the sea).

min_distance_cells.description: Smallest distance of a neighbour island from the start island (behind the cloud cover, B2520).

amplitude.description: Half the tidal range in height units; 0 turns the tides off (R15).

period_ticks.description: Length of one tidal cycle in ticks.

curve.description: Water level over one cycle, interpolated linearly; phases ascending, first 0.

level_permille.description: Level from -1000 (low) to 1000 (high), times the amplitude.

view_range_cells.description: How far an inhabitant sees on flat ground (R14).

height_bonus_per_100_height.description: Extra cells of view per 100 height units above the surroundings (a view helps).

reveal_real_seconds.description: Presentation only: how long newly seen land takes to clear (R25).

node_budget.description: Most nodes one A* search may expand (R10).

cost_flat.description: Cost of one step on flat dry ground.

cost_shallow_water.description: Extra cost of one step through shallow water.

cost_per_slope_unit.description: Extra cost per height unit climbed.

WorldPresetCaves.description: Caves (R6): objects of a catalogue type at the foot of cliffs that rise into the given biome.

object_type.description: Catalogue type placed as a cave.

cliff_biome.description: Biome of the cliff above the cave.

StartSupply.description: Start supply: what every start position finds within sight and within its walkable area, so a new world does not fail on water or food out of reach (TL #19280). Missing items are placed near the start from the island's own spawn rules: only in the biomes of a rule and within its max_total, preferably where the start can walk. (Not the player's start favour.)

radius_cells.description: Radius around each start position in cells (within the inhabitants' perception).

properties_all.description: True properties an object must have.

properties_none.description: True properties it must not have.

min.description: Fewest such objects within the radius of every start position.

mandatory.description: If true, a start that misses this resource within the radius fails the generation attempt, which is then repeated with the next derived sub-seed (deterministic); the check line is start_supply/<id>. If false or absent, the line only reports (report/start_supply/<id>).

width_cm.description: Stream width in centimetres; a stream wider than one cell takes its side cells too.

bank.description: How far the water surface lies below the banks (height units): the stream bed is cut this much plus the depth into the ground.

min_height.description: Springs lie at least this far above sea level (height units).

max_groundwater_depth.description: Springs rise where the groundwater table lies at most this far below the ground (height units, underground layer).

foot_relief.description: A spring cell lies at the foot of a slope or rock edge: the ground within foot_radius_cells rises at least this much above it.

foot_radius_cells.description: Radius in which the foot relief is measured.

max_count.description: Most springs on the island (the wettest candidates first).

discharge.description: Water a spring adds to the flow accumulation of its cell (accumulation units).

at.description: Where the objects lie: spring (exactly on the spring cells), lake_edge (dry walkable cells next to a pond or lake), stream_bank (dry walkable cells next to a running stream).

spacing_cells.description: Smallest distance between two objects of this entry (and from other drink spots).

max_total.description: Most objects of this entry on the island.

min_stream_distance_cells.description: Smallest distance from any running stream cell other than a spring's own (keeps pools off stream mouths); 0 = no limit.

regrow_hours.description: Game hours until a used-up object of this type is there again (same meaning as in the spawn table; all entries of one type must agree). Absent = does not regrow.

fallback_soil.description: Soil of a cell no rule matches.

soil_rules.description: Soil per cell, first matching rule wins (ids such as clay, sand, loam, stone; placeholders).

WorldPresetUnderground.description: The underground truth per cell from the seed (TL #19717, W1672): groundwater depth, soil, stones and ore. Generated and saved with the island; not yet used by actions (digging, wells: B5).

smoothing_radius_cells.description: Radius of the mean ground height the groundwater table follows.

follow_permille.description: How strongly the table follows the smoothed ground above sea level (1000 = fully).

base_depth.description: Depth of the table below the smoothed, followed ground (height units).

noise_amplitude.description: Largest up or down variation of the table (height units).

noise_wavelength_cells.description: Wavelength of that variation in cells.

min_slope.description: Smallest slope (largest height step to a neighbour).

per_slope_permille.description: More stones per unit of slope.

stone_soil_permille.description: More stones where the soil is the stone soil.

stone_soil.description: Soil id that counts as stony.

noise_wavelength_cells.description: Wavelength of that variation in cells.

min_height.description: Ore only at least this far above sea level.

threshold_permille.description: Ore where the ore noise exceeds this value.

max_permille.description: Ore amount where the noise is at its highest.

noise_wavelength_cells.description: Wavelength of the ore noise in cells (veins and pockets).
